messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - Inference latency spike detected in prod-west. Alerting oncall: Maya. War room: https://warroom.redwood.example/warroom/4720012345. Affected: realtime text-generation endpoints. Symptom: tail latency p99 ~3s. No spike in 5xx. Please ack and join.
Maya (oncall): Acked. Joining war room now. Running quick checks: autoscaler, GPU util, kv-cache errors.
Lin (platform): Seeing queue length growth on gpu-pool-west-2. There was a model rollout ~03:12 UTC to v1.4-opt. Could be batching change. Suggest freeze new rollouts and check variant routing.
Sam (eng-sre): I can own mitigation if Maya wants to triage. If it's rollout-related we can rollback to v1.3-quant. Can someone confirm the model rollout timeline?
Paul (support): I'll assemble customer impact list. Quick question: is this only realtime/generation customers or also embeddings/batch?
Maya (oncall): So far only /v1/generate realtime endpoints. Embeddings ok. No customer-facing 5xxs reported yet, just latency regressions for a subset of keys.
Sam (eng-sre): Runbook step 1: Verify per-pool queues and inflight batching. Command I'm running:
```
# list inference pods in west pool
kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=west -o wide
# check queue length metric
promql: sum(rate(inference_queue_length_sum[1m])) by (pool)
```
If rollout is culprit, prepare rollback of model variant routing.
Lin (platform): Confirmed a spike in batching latency by trace ids. I've paused new model promotions for now.
Paul (support): Draft status page (suggested): "We are investigating increased latency for realtime text-generation in the US-West region. Customers may see slower responses (p99 up to ~3s). No errors observed. Our engineers are actively investigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Paul (support): Draft customer DM template:
"Hi <Customer>, we're investigating an increase in response times for realtime inference in US-West. You may experience slower responses; we're working on mitigation and will update you within 15 minutes. —Redwood Incident Team"
Maya (oncall): Handing owner to Sam to execute rollback. I'll stay in war room for coordination and customer comms.
Sam (eng-sre): Taking owner. Plan: rollback variant routing to v1.3-quant (if safe) and monitor p95/p99. I'll post updates after rollback attempt (~15m).
incident-bot: Action logged: escalation to eng-sre. Pager thread pinned to war room. Next update ETA ~15 minutes.
Sam (eng-sre): Started rollback to v1.3-quant now. Monitoring metrics and traces. Will update within 15.
